overview.en:
Inspect Prefect Cloud workflows, deployments, runs, logs and infrastructure with read-only diagnostics.

Inspect deployed workflows and their execution records to understand failures or delays. Keep the environment and run identifiers attached to each finding.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
以只读方式查看 Prefect Cloud 工作流、部署、运行记录、日志与基础设施。

检查已部署工作流与执行记录，了解失败或延迟原因，并为每项发现保留环境与运行标识。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize the recent runs of this workflow and identify failures.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 汇总这个工作流的近期运行，识别失败记录。

starterPrompts.en: Investigate this run using the available logs and execution context.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 使用可用日志与执行上下文调查这次运行。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a troubleshooting brief for this workflow without changing it.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 为这个工作流准备排障简报，先不要修改。

descriptions.en: Use Prefect in Ghast. Inspect Prefect Cloud workflows, deployments, runs, logs and infrastructure with read-only diagnostics. 以只读方式查看 Prefect Cloud 工作流、部署、运行记录、日志与基础设施。
